concept: The accent dot is the product's heartbeat: it pulses on the kick, stretches into the claim's underline, marks each benefit, and grows into the CTA button.

beatMap.lands: The dot pulses on each kick; the brand lands on beat 0 and the claim's words rise on beats 1-3.
The dot drops under the claim on beat 4 and the underline grows in two steps on beats 5 and 6; the claim leaves on beat 7.
Impact-free downbeat: the underline becomes the first benefit marker; benefits 2 and 3 split from it on beats 9 and 10; the reading bar starts on beat 11.
The reading bar slides to the next benefit on each beat; a riser builds from beat 12.
Strongest impact on beat 16: the marker grows into the CTA button on the surface panel; the arrow nudges on each kick; the dot returns home on beat 19.

handoffs.element: The claim's underline becomes the first benefit marker.
The first benefit marker grows into the CTA button.

sound.concept: The kick is the dot's heartbeat; each benefit is a pluck, and the CTA button opens on the final impact.

cueMap.kick: The dot pulses and the beat strip fills on every beat.
cueMap.impact: Beat 16: the button opens on the surface panel.
cueMap.riser: Beats 12-16: the reading bar runs down the benefits.
cueMap.headline: Each claim word rises on its pluck.
cueMap.point1: Benefit markers split from the dot on their plucks.
cueMap.cta: The CTA words land on lead notes.

findings.issue: Max-length brand, headline, points, and CTA clipped.
findings.fix: Text is sized with real font measurement; the button width is measured from the label.

findings.issue: Beats 4-5, 11-14, and 17-18 had no visible motion.
findings.fix: The underline grows in steps on beats 4-6, a reading bar moves row to row, and a beat strip fills on every kick.

findings.issue: Kick motion on the text itself broke the 30-frame readable hold.
findings.fix: Text stays still; separate shapes carry the beat.

approval.waiver: Operator approved shipping to test the mix in production.
